name: Changedetection.io
description: Watch web pages for changes — price drops, restocks, contract renewals — and get notified via ntfy, Discord, Telegram and 80+ services.
compose:
services:
  changedetection:
    image: ghcr.io/dgtlmoon/changedetection.io:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/datastore
    restart: unless-stopped
